t: A small Raspberry Pi camera that runs AI vision right on its own sensor.
steps: Buy the AI Camera from Adafruit, PiShop.us or SparkFun. The official price is 70 US dollars.
Get a Raspberry Pi with a camera connector, a microSD card and a power supply.
Install Raspberry Pi OS on the card with Raspberry Pi Imager.
Connect the camera ribbon cable with the Pi switched off.
Open a terminal and install the imx500-all package, then reboot.
Run rpicam-hello with the MobileNet SSD detection file and watch labels appear.
Wait a few minutes on the first run while the model loads into the camera.
Try the Picamera2 Python examples for pose tracking next.
meta: Open Code. From $69.99. A few stores.
